title: v0.13.0
excerpt: Added 📑 Tabbed workspace. The Tabs button at the top of a chat now opens a workspace for files, multiple terminal sessions, artifacts, previews, voice calls and comments. Add tabs from the + menu, drag to reorder them, and create and save new files directly into the selected terminal. Keep the conversation and its working files together while coding, analyzing data or reviewing generated documents. Commit , Commit , Commit , Commit 🖥️ Open Terminal Desktop tab for computer use. Open the Desktop tab from the + menu to view and control the desktop provided by your connected Open Terminal, with mouse, keyboard, clipboard and audio support where available. With a model that can call its desktop tools, you can follow computer-use workflows in the same desktop and step in yourself: operate graphical apps, inspect generated documents or handle a step that needs manual input. Requires an Open Terminal connection with desktop support enabled. Commit , Commit , Commit , Commit 🌐 Browser tab for browser use and web app testing. Open websites and local development servers beside your chat, with navigation controls, multiple tabs and a mobile viewport. On a compatible Open Terminal connection, Chrome mode gives you and the model a shared browser session for browser automation: navigate sites, interact with forms and test the web apps the model builds. You can watch the work and interact with the page yourself; Proxy mode remains available for previews. Requires browser support on the sele
